title: Chapter 4: The Rusted Line
_comment: Chapter 4 remodel (2026-09-10, v2): map tripled in each dimension (was 60x32). A fourth distinct shape: one long 'Junction Gauntlet' maze with hostiles and a hostage embedded in its corridors (same technique as Chapter 3), but this chapter's riddle is MANDATORY, not bonus-only - three terminal-minds must be reached in the right order to lift a real api.setBarrier gate blocking the key item, the first chapter where solving the puzzle is required to progress, not just rewarded. Layout: surface entry (cols 2-28), the Junction Gauntlet maze (30-165, full playable height), the gated end vault (167-178).
